title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 Madhya Pradesh had the highest capacity of inmates (5044) in various Sub-Jails. This was followed by the States of Tamil Nadu (3693), Orissa (2829), Andhra Pradesh (2585), Karnataka (2397), Kerala (1737), Rajasthan (1763) and West Bengal (1662). The States of Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Jammu & Kashmir, Punjab and West Bengal have not reported about the capacity of subjails existing in their jurisdiction.
